clarification: Assist only canonical workers and repository-native execution lanes whose durable lineage intersects a current session goal. Do not select unrelated ecosystem work merely because it is active or adjacent.
scope_rule: Every assisted worker/task must map to a goal in the v5 inventory and must respect current claim/collision ownership before mutation.

goal_families.priority_rule: Assist only within declared noncolliding support boundaries. Do not manually start machine-owned provider/trade execution or wallet signing/broadcast.
Remove unnecessary recurring GitHub-hosted execution immediately where capability is preserved; necessary recurring operational work is a StegVerse-worker transfer candidate.
Close/supersede exact duplicates and obsolete work only after current handoff/claim/evidence checks; preserve active claims, protected/release branches and evaluation evidence.

Reduce workflow files to the minimum technically necessary, preferably 0/1/2. Classify every surface as KEEP_STANDALONE_EXCEPTION, CONSOLIDATE_INTO_STABLE_DISPATCHER, TRANSFER_TO_STEGVERSE_WORKER, or ELIMINATE. Counts above two require evidence-backed technical necessity.

worker_selection_procedure: Read the v5 session inventory before selecting work.
Read the repository-local applicable *_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md before mutation.
Reject tasks without direct lineage to a current session goal.
Inspect current claims and collision scope before implementation.
Prefer unclaimed cleanup/consolidation work over competing with machine-owned execution.
For workflow removals, preserve necessary capability by dispatcher consolidation or StegVerse-worker transfer before deletion unless the capability itself is obsolete/redundant.
Persist merge/validation evidence and update the applicable handoff after meaningful state change.
archive_effect: NONE_BY_ITSELF; active cleanup/minimization and trade-readiness goals remain archival dependencies.
